decision.reasoning_trace: The search results were cluttered with irrelevant camping gear like stoves, pillows, and patches, which reduced the overall quality of the browsing experience. Among the actual backpacks, the majority were highly specialized for niche activities (fishing, disc golf, baseball, hydration) rather than versatile daily use. While the Scothen Cooler Backpack and Sojourner Hydration Pack initially seemed appealing, their reviews mentioned significant durability issues like leaking and liner tears. The general-purpose hiking packs also had concerning reports of straps failing or seams wearing out within a short time. Due to the lack of high-quality, general-purpose options and the prevalence of specialized or low-durability items, I decided not to make a purchase.
